title: ElevenLabs Voice Isolator: Remove Background Noise From Creator Recordings
markdown:
If you are deciding whether to add an Instagram transcription tool to a creator workflow, start with the material you need to turn into reusable text: a Reel, Story, or Live. ElevenLabs presents its Instagram transcript generator for creating text that can be used for captions, alt text, and repurposed posts. [ElevenLabs Instagram Transcript Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/instagram-transcript-generator)

A practical evaluation is to use a short, representative recording rather than assuming every source will need the same edits. The product page says you can paste a Reel link or upload a saved Story or Live, then edit words, trim filler, split segments, and use word-level timestamps to keep edits aligned to the video. [ElevenLabs Instagram Transcript Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/instagram-transcript-generator)

Check the available input and export options before making the tool part of a publishing process. ElevenLabs lists MP4, MOV, MKV, and other major video or audio formats as upload options. It lists SRT and VTT for subtitles; TXT, DOCX, PDF, JSON, and HTML are also listed as export formats. [ElevenLabs Instagram Transcript Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/instagram-transcript-generator)

Cost is another decision point. The pricing page lists a Free plan with 10,000 credits per month, while Starter is listed at $6 per month with 30,000 credits and Creator at $22 per month with 121,000 credits. ElevenLabs says credits are shared across products and lists Speech to Text at approximately 330 credits per minute. Listed prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. [ElevenLabs pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

For teams or developers, confirm the delivery path you need. ElevenLabs presents browser-based use through its web platform and also lists an Audio to Text API and SDK with WebSocket and REST APIs. [ElevenLabs Instagram Transcript Generator](https://elevenlabs.io/instagram-transcript-generator)

A sensible decision checklist is simple: test a representative Instagram clip, review and correct the transcript, verify that your intended upload and export formats are available, and estimate transcription minutes against the shared credit pool. Those checks help determine whether the published workflow fits your captioning, subtitle, or repurposing process.
